scope: Only provably absent historical attachments degrade to bounded ephemeral notice; current and invalid inputs fail closed.
implementation: Dedicated typed Available/Missing/Invalid native source; immutable owner and physical profile/mount roots captured on host thread; read handles with no delete sharing plus final-path/identity checks.
Snapshot fallback permitted only on Missing. Invalid snapshot remains fatal even if original SHA would match. Existing HTTP AttachmentStore and AttachmentPipeline methods unchanged.

Current-row-first exact ref/hash selection and newest summary boundary retained. Missing current is fatal; missing historical only omitted after absent cache and original; recorded durable file deletion/corruption remains fatal.
Notice preserves canonical history, sends only logical labels as JSON; <=32 labels and8192 encoded label bytes with total/omitted counts.
No adapter, Engine, raw history, credentials, image transport or permission changes.

before.interpretation: Three unavailable-history rows reproduce blocked turns. Six corrupt/locked snapshot rows reproduce prior fallback to matching SHA-verified original, not changed-byte dispatch or an owner bypass; strict Invalid-vs-Missing policy is intentional tightening.

scopePinBefore.interpretation: READ_ATTRIBUTES handle did not deny directory rename on this Windows build. Dedicated helper now retains GENERIC_READ no-delete-sharing handles; same assertion passes.

review.qt_port_review: Bounded source review found no extra classification/lifetime defect before final strong-handle refinement; no independent runtime tests claimed.

limits: Windows MinGW only; typed absence unsupported elsewhere.
Availability is checked during preparation; no atomic snapshot across all historical files is claimed.
Historical durable replay is a native extension; pinned ACP replays historical text only and uses a textual fallback for failed current-file reads.
This strict Invalid-vs-Missing distinction is intentionally narrower than pinned catch-all fallback.
This private66-case run is not the parent full shared gate or universal parity proof.
Direct CLI filesystem permissions for external captured paths remain unchanged; these tests use native fake child protocols, not live models.
